milestones.title: Traceable data ingestion
milestones.detail: Source records, content-addressed Frags, corpus Blueprints and token replay.

milestones.title: Multiple tokenizer profiles
milestones.detail: GPT-2, SmolLM2 and o200k profiles with CPU/GPU vector reconstruction.

milestones.title: Peer discovery and role topology
milestones.detail: Signed DHT records, role discovery and separate node execution.

milestones.title: Consensus and distributed training
milestones.detail: Four-validator Oracle, shared-manifest training, expiring leases and verified checkpoints.

milestones.title: Model lineage and executable export
milestones.detail: Qwen3 fine-tuning, source-to-token checks, signed records and verified weight merging.

milestones.title: Network continuity
milestones.detail: Verified state publication, retained state during a split and checked recovery.

milestones.title: Full-epoch deterministic replay
milestones.detail: 228 updates replayed; 392/392 identical tensors, zero L2 difference. CPU checks confirmed tokens and exported weights.

milestones.title: Network observability
milestones.detail: Role-based web and terminal dashboards, current node state, activity history and aggregate resource counters.

milestones.title: Seed II: corpus and model growth
milestones.detail: 40.6M parameters trained from scratch over four epochs; 8,577 documents including 378 Norwegian texts. Paired evaluation and exact model/AdamW interval replay.

milestones.title: Shared manifests and model branches
milestones.detail: Homogeneous execution cohorts, explicit participation and independently selectable model branches; signed protocol tests preserve exact verification.

milestones.title: Training recovery and verifier replacement
milestones.detail: Opt-in failure reports, rejection/reassignment, revision fencing and cancellation preserve full replay quorum. Signed transition and HTTP fault tests pass; the new worker deployment trial is next.

milestones.title: Distributed optimizer state
milestones.detail: Extend Qwen/AdamW training contracts with optimizer-state exchange and DiLoCo-style outer updates.

milestones.title: Numerical verification across hardware
milestones.detail: Calibrate numerical verification across GPUs and runtimes; extend branch selection and contribution policies.

milestones.title: Independent operators and WAN hardening
milestones.detail: Admission and revocation, authenticated transport, eclipse resistance and adversarial testing.

milestones.title: Durable artifact availability
milestones.detail: Ongoing possession challenges, retention leases, repair and broader checkpoint replication.

milestones.title: Measured sampling and quality gates
milestones.detail: Compare full replay with post-commitment interval sampling; measure detection, cost and quality against adversarial updates.

milestones.title: Model splitting and larger workloads
milestones.detail: Training partitions across devices, sustained multi-machine runs and scaling measurements.

milestones.title: Worker compute accounting
milestones.detail: Emit operation counts from training and verification kernels; expand transport measurements across independent nodes.

milestones.title: Foundation and collective funding
milestones.detail: Tiered API service revenue, auditable contribution rewards and a foundation whose administration grows with service demand. Begin with metering and simulated accounting.
